title: Structured Data Extractor Input
description: Scrapes one or more URLs and extracts structured data validated against a JSON Schema using a Groq-compatible LLM.

start_urls.title: URLs to scrape
start_urls.description: List of URLs to scrape and extract data from. Each URL is processed independently.

output_schema.title: Output JSON Schema
output_schema.description: A JSON Schema object describing the structure of the data to extract. If omitted, defaults to an e-commerce product schema.

groq_api_key.title: API Key
groq_api_key.description: Your Groq API key (or API key for any OpenAI-compatible provider). Get a free Groq key at console.groq.com.

model.title: Model name
model.description: Model to use for extraction. Defaults to llama-3.3-70b-versatile (Groq free tier).

base_url.title: API Base URL
base_url.description: Base URL of the OpenAI-compatible API. Defaults to Groq. Use https://api.openai.com/v1 for OpenAI, https://api.together.xyz/v1 for Together AI, or http://localhost:11434/v1 for Ollama.
